title: Equality of finite-word tape conventions
statement: For every finite Boolean word $w$, the tape that is blank at negative cells and stores the entries of $w$ at their corresponding nonnegative indices, blank when no entry exists, is equal as a function on the integer cells to the canonical buffer tape storing $w$.
replaced: For every bit list $w$, the tape holding $w$ on the nonnegative cells with blanks elsewhere coincides with the library's canonical buffer tape for $w$, including every negative cell and both empty-word boundaries.
